business_problem: Incrementa needed to centralize campaign data from multiple advertising channels, cut the time analysts spent producing insight, and turn raw marketing performance data into strategic recommendations that could scale across all clients.
solution_summary: Incrementa built a Google Cloud analytics environment that combines Cloud Run, BigQuery, and Gemini Enterprise Standard to convert multi-channel marketing data into faster strategic insight. Cloud Run extracts campaign-performance information from advertising APIs such as Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok, then loads it into BigQuery as a secure single source of truth. Gemini Enterprise Standard sits on top of that warehouse as the natural-language front end, combining the structured campaign data with unstructured context such as brand manuals and client contracts stored in Microsoft OneDrive. This lets Incrementa analyze complete campaign histories in hours instead of a week and return detailed recommendations instead of just raw metrics. The platform turned campaign analysis from a manual reporting function into a scalable advisory engine that now supports all clients and allows the agency to focus more time on growth.
